description: TOPICAL_DATABASE — 14 topical products with matching tags, scalp compatibility, gender, contraindications, usage, and mechanism data. Extracted from DrFACT_revamp_v44.html lines 2037–2103.

products.name: Minoxidil 5%
products.usage: Apply once daily to the affected scalp area as directed by the doctor.
products.note: Growth active for pattern thinning; avoid for female patients during pregnancy or conception planning

products.name: Minoxidil 2% + Finasteride 0.25% Topical
products.usage: Apply at night on thinning zones only under doctor supervision.
products.note: Doctor-choice topical for androgen-sensitive thinning; avoid in pregnancy or conception planning

products.name: Minoxidil + Spironolactone Topical
products.usage: Use only if prescribed for PCOS or androgen-linked female thinning.
products.note: Avoid during pregnancy or conception planning

products.name: Ketoconazole Lotion / Shampoo
products.usage: Use twice weekly; keep contact for 3-5 minutes before rinsing unless advised otherwise.
products.note: Effective for Malassezia-driven dandruff, itching and oily scalp inflammation

products.name: Ketoconazole + Growth Serum Combo
products.usage: Use ketoconazole twice weekly and a non-irritating growth serum on alternate nights.
products.note: Best fit when dandruff and hairfall are both active

products.name: F-Emugrow MCRD
products.usage: Apply to the affected scalp area as directed by the doctor. Massage gently for 2–3 minutes. Do not rinse. Use once daily or as prescribed.
products.note: Suitable for pattern hair loss, thinning, and post-hair transplant care. Avoid in pregnancy or planning to conceive.
products.ingredients: Emu Oil · Redensyl 3% · Dutasteride 0.5% · Clove Oil · Caffeine · Zinc Oxide · Copper Tripeptide · Magnesium Oxide · Melatonin
products.mechanism: Dutasteride (0.5%) inhibits both Type I and Type II 5-alpha reductase — blocking DHT conversion more completely than Finasteride alone. Redensyl (3%) activates hair follicle stem cells and dermal papilla cell proliferation (anagen re-entry). Emu Oil improves dermal penetration of all co-delivered actives. Copper Tripeptide + Caffeine stimulate follicle microcirculation. Melatonin prolongs the anagen growth phase.

products.name: Trichogain Serum
products.usage: Apply once daily or on alternate nights to thinning areas as tolerated.
products.note: Non-minoxidil option for sensitive or dry scalp

products.name: CR Serum
products.usage: Apply on alternate nights unless the doctor changes frequency.
products.note: Gentler topical support when harsh actives are not preferred

products.name: F-Trichosure Pro
products.usage: Apply as prescribed for female hormonal thinning support.
products.note: Useful in peri-menopause, menopause or post-menopause related thinning

products.name: Premature Greying Topical Support
products.usage: Use as directed on scalp or hair roots; pair with the prescribed greying kit.
products.note: Topical support for early greying concerns

products.name: F-Trichosilk D&F (Without Treatment)
products.usage: Apply a small amount to damp or dry hair from mid-length to ends. Do not rinse. Use daily or as recommended by the doctor.
products.note: Leave-in serum for dry and frizzy hair. Keeps frizz in check, prevents knots and tangles, hydrates the hair. Light and non-greasy formula. Recommended for everyday use.
products.ingredients: Light leave-in serum complex; moisture-protective, anti-frizz, shine-enhancing. Non-greasy formula for dry and frizzy hair without heat or chemical treatment history.
products.mechanism: Hydrates and coats hair shaft. Anti-frizz, moisture-protection and shine-enhancing. No active pharmaceutical ingredient.

products.name: F-Trichosilk D&F (With Treatment)
products.usage: Apply a small amount to damp or dry hair from mid-length to ends. Do not rinse. Use daily as a heat protectant before styling or as a finishing serum.
products.note: Leave-in serum for treated and damaged hair. Boosts moisture and repairs hair fibres. Prevents dryness and frizziness. Heat protectant.
products.ingredients: Leave-in serum with heat protectant complex; moisture-boosting, fibre-repair, anti-frizz, shine and bounce enhancing. For chemically treated or heat-damaged hair.
products.mechanism: Heat protectant shield. Fibre repair, moisture retention, anti-frizz. No active pharmaceutical ingredient.

products.name: F-Biwash+ Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
products.usage: Use 2–3 times per week on wash days. Apply to wet scalp, lather gently for 3–5 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Doctor to confirm frequency based on severity.
products.note: Medicated anti-dandruff shampoo — reduces visible flakes, relieves itching, improves scalp hygiene. Effective in treatment of Dandruff and Seborrheic Dermatitis.
products.ingredients: Medicated anti-dandruff complex; formulated to manage dandruff, scalp flaking, and itching. Gently cleanses while controlling dandruff-causing factors.
products.mechanism: Antimicrobial and antifungal scalp cleansing. Controls Malassezia-driven dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis.

products.name: Trichonourish EVA / FHA-Andro+
products.usage: Apply as directed by doctor to affected facial areas.
products.note: Anti-androgen topical formulation targeting androgen-sensitive facial follicles — reduce unwanted facial hair growth driven by PCOS androgen excess. Avoid in pregnancy or planning to conceive.
